notes: panda_control v4 chirp (gen_chirp_traj.py), the README's recommended Franka operating point. Linear chirp 0.1->0.7 Hz on all six Cartesian DOF, phase-staggered at k*pi/3, asymmetric 2 s up / 3 s down linear envelope, returns to the anchor at t=T. Amplitudes are UR5e's, with f1 lowered 3.0 -> 0.7 Hz for the Franka. At full amplitude this exceeds panda_control's own peak conventions (0.30 m/s, 0.50 rad/s) by design, and max|rot_offset| reaches ~0.61 rad; excite_panda.py's probe scales the amplitudes down to fit our EE_DELTA envelope, which brings both back inside.
track_abort_note: panda_control relaxes these for the chirp (README: error_delta_pos 0.05 -> 0.15, error_delta_rot 0.30 -> 0.80) because the reference itself reaches ~0.61 rad of rotation offset and a soft kp lags it. At 0.30 the episode aborts mid-run.
